name: Tiko Timer
subtitle: A visual timer for children
promotional_text: See time pass. A calm, visual countdown timer that helps children understand how long is left.
description:
Tiko Timer is a visual countdown timer built for children. A clear, shrinking arc shows exactly how much time is left — making 'five more minutes' something a child can actually see and understand.

Great for routines, transitions, turn-taking and focus.

- Big, friendly visual countdown
- Set a time in seconds
- Clear, calm alerts when time is up
- No ads, no distractions

Part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
